results.title: Still, Tijuana
results.overview: In Playas de Tijuana, a young queer man fleeing Russia to avoid being conscripted in the Ukraine war due to his identity, and a middle-aged gay man navigating Northern Mexican machismo, connect through a gay hookup app where they hide behind digital alter egos. When their relationship moves offline, they come face to face with the wounds inflicted by their respective exiles.

results.title: Nevatars
results.overview: Aya, an aspiring artist obsessed with perfection, hides the quirky, deeply personal creations that reflect her true artistic voice inside a forgotten folder called “Nevatars.” But when her newest “perfect” character is accidentally dropped into that hidden world of discarded digital no-hopers, an unlikely escape mission forces Aya to confront the parts of herself she almost abandoned forever.

results.title: AMINETU
results.overview: In November 2009, Aminetu Haidar returns to El Aaiún after receiving the Civil Courage Prize in New York, only to be expelled without a passport and sent to Lanzarote. There, she begins a 32-day hunger strike, turning the right to return home into a quiet but unyielding confrontation.

results.title: Shadow on a marble tablet
results.overview: Feature-length experimental film. Accompanied live performances by Grouper in her fall 2026 tour.

results.title: The Remotes
results.overview: A grieving detective finds himself increasingly ensnared while investigating a case involving a sinister navigation app causing physical and psychological debris.

results.title: Interference
results.overview: Different people walk along the same street and talk about strange things. References to an approaching end gradually appear in their everyday conversations.

results.title: The Winning Generation
results.overview: The Winning Generation is a documentary filmed over 12 years, following Shahen Harutyunyan from a 14-year-old activist to an emerging political leader. Carrying the legacy of his father and grandfather in Armenia's long struggle for independence, he transforms their tradition of resistance into a new democratic vision. As Armenia navigates political instability and strong Russian influence, Shahen seeks to forge his own path while redefining what a new generation's fight for freedom could look like.

results.title: The Box in the Attic
results.overview: After the death of her estranged mother, a troubled woman returns to her childhood home and discovers a box. When she breaks its seal, she unleashes malevolent entities tied to a dark family legacy and a deadly secret of her own.

results.title: Mither
results.overview: During the evacuation of her island home, Rebecca McKay refuses to leave due to her belief that her missing son may still be alive. Despite the insistence of her husband Calum, to abandon hope, Rebecca goes to extremes to find an answer.

results.title: Kim Novak's Vertigo
results.overview: Explores Kim Novak's life, highlighting her role in Alfred Hitchcock's Vertigo, and her journey from stardom to a reclusive life as an artist in Oregon, using rare archival footage and Novak's own reflections.

results.title: Don't Breathe a Word
results.overview: Meredith runs a Lamaze business and hires Eve, who becomes her best friend. When Eve is stalked, Meredith is determined to help. As she investigates, Meredith discovers Eve might be hiding a dark secret.

results.title: The Evaluation
results.overview: A psychiatrist evaluates a prisoner who claims he is possessed by an ancient evil. When the entity exposes the doctor's deepest weakness, the line between doctor and patient begins to disappear.

results.title: Crocodile Tears
results.overview: An overbearing mother who lives with her son in a secluded crocodile farm spirals out of control when her son sees the outside world and falls for a girl for the first time.

results.title: Don't Come Upstairs
results.overview: They were taught one rule: never ask Dad what he does. Don’t Come Upstairs is a documentary that unravels the secret filmmaker Mike Lobel’s father Eric kept hidden—his decades-long role as a prominent drug distributor in Canada. Told through home videos and interviews with family members, this isn’t just about Eric’s double life—it’s about the impact his secrecy had on his family. Exploring generational trauma, the fallout of parental choices, and the hope that comes with facing hard truths in pursuit of healing and connection, Lobel's film builds to a final familial confrontation where one more truth is revealed.

results.title: Fathers
results.overview: A young girl (Natalie) is kidnapped but it's not long until we realize things are much more complex as her captor presents a completely different picture. Natalie must figure out what is actually true and what isn't before it's too late.

results.title: Welcome to the Game >ClintsChapter
results.overview: After being blackmailed by two detectives, Clint Edwards is on the hunt for a missing woman with vital information. He searches the Dark Web for clues, but some unwanted guests come to visit-and they don't want to help.  Based Off The Hit Video Game Series by Reflect Studios

results.title: EDJOP
results.overview: Based on the life of Edgar Jopson, a young man from an affluent family, who became an underground activist and confronted President Ferdinand Marcos and his regime of terror.

results.title: Little Ghost Laban Goes on Pranking
results.overview: Laban the Little Ghost is back with a new collection of cozy and just-spooky-enough adventures at the Good Morning Sun Castle. Together with his little sister Labolina and his best friend, the Little Prince, their days are filled with everything from trick-or-treating, birthday celebrations, and lost Christmas presents to unexpected guests and many other fun experiences.

results.title: Saved
results.overview: Vera manages to escape from her captor after 17 years of captivity. Her friend Nicholas is the only person left she can rely on to return to a normal life, but something seems to haunt her.
